summary: Skyline Builders Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the sale of its 13.09% membership interest in Reemag LLC (plus associated subscription rights) for $3,000,000 cash via an Assignment and Assumption Agreement dated May 14, 2026. The sale terminates future obligations under an amended subscription agreement, including rights to acquire additional interests at three tranches (up to 50.10%). No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transaction is a straightforward divestiture of an equity stake for cash. What to watch: implications for Skyline's strategic direction and use of proceeds.
